notes: Recorded under the owner's AFK mandate, continuing through the ranked remainder after the replay-store seam and the deployable backends. Item 3 is the keysources — 3 of 17 files owned in this area with 108 controls between them — and this registers the ONE authority in it that is a SEALED OWNER rather than a provider adapter. Recorded by the implementing agent as routine owner-review maintenance, not as a transcription of a ruling naming this fingerprint. WHY THIS IS A THEOREM AND NOT A REGISTRATION OF THREE TYPE DEFINITIONS: the module states its own operational test, and it is R-SEAL's quantifier rather than a construction-site check — delete every length check elsewhere and an over-long signature is still unconstructible. THREE UNCONSTRUCTIBLE WRONG VALUES AND ONE RE-VERIFICATION. The pre-hash arm is the subtle one: ED25519_PH_SHA_512 with MessageType DIGEST is a legitimate KMS operation over the very same key, and a backend selecting it returns a well-formed 64-byte signature that simply does not verify over the raw preimage — no length check finds it and the provider returns no error. It is unreachable because the type admits no digest arm, and the missing input is NAMED rather than fabricated, so a pre-hashed variant would arrive as a sibling type and every backend's match would fail to compile until it said what it does with it. THE MISMATCHED KEY IS THE CASE THAT SURVIVES THE OTHER TWO: a backend wired to the wrong KMS key produces a valid Ed25519 signature, of the right length, over the right message, under the wrong key. Only the seam's re-verification against the signer's OWN advertised response_public_key catches it, which is why that check sits at the seam rather than in each adapter — an adapter that forgets is exactly the case it exists for. The adapters self-verify too and that is kept as defence in depth, but the property holds for ANY backend because it holds here. A MEASURED FACT ABOUT THE EVIDENCE, recorded rather than smoothed over. Probe M128 weakens the 64-byte interpretation and names only kms_keysource::protocol_operands::tests::only_sixty_four_bytes_make_a_signature as expected red. The neighbouring control wrong_length_signature_fails_closed drives a 63-byte backend through the WHOLE signer, so the padded result is then caught by the seam's re-verification and the control stays green under that weakening. Naming it would have been a false claim about what the probe proved. The double defence is a fact about the design, not a gap. WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED, in the scope: nothing about the provider adapters — gcp_kms_keysource.rs at 2660 lines with 39 controls, aws_kms_keysource.rs and aws_sts.rs are BENEATH this seam and belong to no unit, so nothing here says any of them speaks its protocol correctly, selects the right key or reaches the intended endpoint; nothing about key custody, which is the provider's property and the trait's shape rather than a result proved here; and nothing about the failure path. The public-key rule itself is not implemented here but owned under ADR-MCPRE-063 Slice 2, and this seam maps that owner's three distinctions into a one-variant vocabulary by rendering them into the message rather than losing them. NOT ABSORBED: remote_signer_call, three files and ten controls, decides whether a failed signer call means the account is out of quota or this request was bad — which arms the handshake-path throttle, where a missed throttle is a handshake flood and a spurious one refuses handshakes on a healthy signer. It is gated on any(aws_kms_keysource, gcp_kms_keysource), the shape ADR-MCPRE-061 records as the trap, because a unit naming ONE feature measures the module under that one and says nothing about the other. It needs a slice measuring both lanes and is recorded as a named gap. OUTSIDE EVERY ROOT'S CLOSURE: no root's response-signing claim is stated at this seam, and the delegated-signing terminal roots consume is proxy.delegated_signing_credential's. Probes M128 and M129 red-verified on this tree. The fingerprint was recomputed after the last edit and equals the value above. Reviewed tree: assurance/kms-ed25519-seam.
